div.head: Iud Dei I 14
div.ab: Praefatio. Uere dignum, aeterne Deus, qui non solum peccata dimittis, sed ipsos etiam iustificas peccatores, et reis non tantum poenas relaxas, sed dona largiris et praemia;
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 403 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
